title: ARCADE: SPAWN SHIELD
why: His order for the Halloween party mode, build 9 of 20. In the arcade a player is put down shielded at every drop, respawn and re-drop: nothing hurts him and a hit only sparks teal on the bubble, so a newcomer who picks up the pad is never killed before he has found the stick. A pulsing teal bubble and SHIELD . MOVE TO START sit on him. The shield drops the moment he moves, rolls, shoots or throws; aiming and searching keep it. The other window draws the same bubble on him. Normal raids are untouched.
now: In the arcade every drop, respawn and re-drop is shielded until the player moves, rolls, shoots or throws.
